maintenance.title: Maintenance and repairs

computers.description: Custom PC assembly with compatibility checks, component installation, cable management, BIOS/UEFI, drivers, and stability tests. Components and licences are quoted separately.

networks.description: Diagnosis and setup of home or small-business networks: routers, Wi-Fi, coverage, cabling, DNS, devices, and network troubleshooting. The base price excludes materials and additional work.

security.title: Security and data protection
security.description: Basic security setup for devices, accounts, and data: encryption, MFA, backups, permission reviews, and practical recommendations to reduce risk. The base price excludes materials and additional work.
